No worries, though, it worked on another shelf that didn't have a basket directly opposite on the door.  Be sure to check the measurements of your counter-depth fridge before ordering!

I’ve used these for several months and cannot be happier. These are less expensive than many you find in the stores and saves room in the fridge for more important items.
Easy to clean, light weight and easy to remove from the fridge. I highly recommend this item.

holds fourteen eggs, takes having stuff set on it and so far has been pretty good at clean-up and keeping the eggs until they're used.

So much better than I expected!  I love that it holds fourteen eggs.  I'm using two of them and they stack so nicely.  The material seems very sturdy and durable.  I really like the handle on one of the sides and the way the lid sits perfectly. I previously used a bowl to store my eggs in the fridge and these utilize the space so much better.

Opening and closing the box that eggs come in was a pain in the neck.  I had to take the box out of the refrigerator to get an egg,  close the box and refrigerate .  Now all I have to do is lift a lid and get an egg or 2 out of the container right out of the refrigerator.  I am ordering another one to keep more eggs in storage as I usually buy 1 1/2 dozen at a time.
This is a wonderful item to have in your refrigerator. I have several now and keeps my eggs fresh and unbroken.

These are great. I debated over which egg holders to get for days. Mostly due to lack of info. I finally decided on these. They’re tough, well made and most importantly: they hold big eggs. I always purchase XL eggs and they fit beautifully. I can’t guarantee it because I haven’t tried, but my guess is they’d fit jumbo size as well. Someone said in a review that they’re too slippery. I didn’t find that to be the case at all. There’s a lip on them so when you stack them, they don’t slide everywhere. My only complaint is that it doesn’t hold just a couple more eggs. When I buy a flat, I have to leave a few out from my two containers. I knew that was an issue though. These are a definite buy.

The lid warped in the top shelf of my Bosch dishwasher. Fit in the top door shelf of my Sub-Zero, but not my basement Amana, so check your dimensions. Wish it stored 24 eggs (Costco flat) as opposed to the 18 that it has.

At first, I wondered why this holds 14 eggs when they come by the dozen, but after I bought it, I realized that there were frequently times we had only one or two eggs left by the time we bought a new dozen and it's a nice way to hold the old ones with the new dozen.  Nice, well made container and you can immediately see how many eggs you have left.  It's sturdy and you can carry it with one hand, as long as you're gripping the top and bottom together.  The top does not snap on, it just rests on top with a fitted rim so it doesn't slide.  Even though this seems like a superfluous purchase, an egg box to replace the egg box you buy them in, it actually makes it easier to see your eggs, can contain any breaks or fluid and not soak through like an egg box, and looks nicer in the fridge.  I'm glad I bought it!

I ordered this because I buy eggs that do not come in a carton. It is a durable, heavy plastic. The only flaw is the top does not fasten to the bottom. There have been many times I have almost dropped the whole thing due to it slipping out of my hands. Other than that, I really like it and it fits perfectly on the shelf in the refrigerator without taking up too much room.
When raising chickens you always need egg holders. These containers are fantastic to transport eggs to family members.

I am extra and wanted to have an organized fridge and this works great for eggs. If you get store-bought eggs you just transfer them over OR if you get eggs from a local farm then you can just bring the container to fill it up or recycle old egg cartons. I like how this is a container that can help limit the waste of an egg carton if you buy more local eggs. It looks great in the fridge and you can see how many eggs you have left, so you know when you need to buy more. The lid is a little strange because it just sits on the top and covers it, but it is flat and lets me put a container over top to save even more space. I used this in college and it especially helped to keep my things separate from my roommates to help make sure we all used our own food

The product description claims that the dimensions are 14.5" L x 4.5" W x 3" H. When I received the product, the measured length is 16", not 14.5". If you are trying to use this product in a built-in refrigerator like a Subzero, it will not fit. The 14.5" is mis-leading because it excludes the handle length of 1.5" which prevents one from closing the door of the refrigerator. Beyond the mis-leading length information, the product looks like it is well made and functional.
